assertions.assertion: Cardiac event monitoring is coded with CPT 93271
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The appeal is of the CO-97 denial
The service is considered bundled under current policy guidelines
